acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retained as the closest registered environment gate, but the repaired bundle must bind the necessity endpoint, gain denominator, nonpositive-gain behavior, and both no-memory controllers; otherwise it cannot discharge the identified necessity concerns.
Retained as the closest lifecycle/provenance gate, but a repaired proposal must add executable identity, traversal, selector-taint, and claim-type support-sufficiency coverage.
Retained as the closest prefix-isolation gate, but a repaired proposal must formalize immutable lifecycle snapshots, status indices, selector inputs, caches, and checkpoint cut semantics.
Retained as the oracle/read/resolver factorial, but it does not by itself establish protocol neutrality, reader-channel equivalence, or a complete paper-facing baseline set.
Retained as the closest solution-boundary gate, but a repaired proposal must add pre-decision cited-read masking or substitution to test causal faithfulness.
Retained as the closest sequential-action gate, but its A4-ready fixture does not establish controlled revision behavior or runtime durability.
Retained as the text/binding suite, but a repaired proposal must separately control shuffle-induced corpus composition changes and bind substrate-neutral accounting.
Retained as the transport suite, but it cannot make the existing resource or gain rules executable and does not cure missing strong-baseline coverage.
Retained as the closest visibility/reset gate, but it lacks exact goal bytes, reader-channel fields, selector declassification, and runtime durability fixtures.
Retained as the required future bundle/review boundary. It correctly requires a new proposed change and human-bound approval, so it cannot authorize implementation from the present artifact.
Retained as the confirmation gate, but its estimator, multiplicity family, optional expansion rule, split manifest, and endpoint interpretation remain unbound.
Retained as the independent-review gate. It remains mandatory after repaired pre-GPU evidence and cannot override unresolved technical requirements.

agreements: The fixed scripted common deck is appropriate for identifying memory representation and use under common experience, but cannot establish an on-policy experiential flywheel.
Evaluation outcomes must remain sealed, reporting-only, and incapable of mutating source-life semantic state, corpus, adapter, or later dream inputs.
A legal constructive result may use several atomic premises through adaptive recurrent reads; neither one record nor one reader return may contain an answer-bearing plan.

The intended positive result is organism-level and ledger-bounded; it does not establish LoRA sufficiency, autonomous discovery, learned THINK/DREAM policy, recurrent-sleep superiority, continual learning, scaling, external validity, or general intelligence.
An exact executable bundle followed by fresh interpretations, critique, consensus, explicit human approval, CPU gates, and independent pre-GPU review is required before implementation or GPU science.

The current proposal materially improves on the superseded pilot through prefix isolation, chronology, sequential actions, provenance restrictions, common-deck contrasts, and explicit claim firewalls.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the current artifact deliberately defers executable bytes while labeling implementation-precondition tests whose fixtures require implementation. The authority stages are therefore circular unless separately bound.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Create a newly hash-bound execution-bundle change that distinguishes design ratification, reference-harness work, scientific implementation, CPU execution, GPU execution, and claim promotion, with fail-closed authority checks.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: declared public-goal visibility is not a byte-level noninterference contract.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind canonical goal/state serialization and permitted transformations, then add collision-pair noninterference coverage across prompts, query arguments, candidate construction/order, and reader serialization.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: a common nominal reader type does not constrain candidate multiplicity, ranking, metadata, omissions, timing, or backend-specific failures.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind an identical model-visible reader channel and test counts, ordering, fields, failures, truncation, timing class, and backend indistinguishability across applicable common-interface arms.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: immutable earlier checkpoints and later chronological support are compatible only through explicit append-only later snapshots.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind lifecycle snapshot eligibility and require suffix changes to leave every earlier status index, selector, compiler input, cache, corpus, adapter, and audit artifact unchanged.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: public-handle-only selector payloads can still encode unsupported branch decisions through replay selection.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind selector schema, source-branch status, permitted dependency closure, and declassification receipts; reject selectors descended from terminal, unsupported, or evaluation-only branches.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: root deduplication alone does not define when a reusable relation is supported.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind claim-type-specific evidence requirements, committed predictions, contrast requirements, exception treatment, and a generator-level dependence criterion beyond root-set deduplication.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: named fixtures do not define canonical identity through revisions, aliases, realizations, and equivalence classes.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind canonical identity and traversal semantics and add generative property coverage for revisions, aliases, diamonds, canonical equivalents, true cycles, and descendant cycles.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: a valid retrospective DAG is not evidence that its cited reads caused the chosen action.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add pre-decision masking, swapping, or counterfactual replacement of cited values and require the predicted item-level action change; retain prior-driven uncited successes as action-only successes.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: task-specific query ontology, candidate recognition, and resolver routing may implement the decisive traversal.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add generic-versus-task-specific query, candidate-recognition, and native explicit-structure ablations under separately reported resource ledgers; restrict claims to the bundled protocol unless they pass.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the proposed confirmation lacks required standard-context, reflection/lesson, and native explicit-structure comparisons identified by the project thesis.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind the paper-facing baseline manifest, including honest full transcript while it fits, pinned native context, reflection/lesson memory, and separately reported native explicit graph or skill memory.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: equal query/action counts do not equate retained capacity, candidate enumeration, retrieval, inference, or training resources.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind a substrate-neutral ledger for active and retained bytes, index state, candidate enumeration, retrieval and reader compute, model-visible tokens, training resources, thinker computation, and actions.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the present fixed A0-A3 assay can test bounded within-item replanning plumbing, not durable revision learning or reconsolidation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add preregistered contradiction/exception targets requiring observation-triggered backtracking and improved later action while proving evaluation outcomes do not become durable memory; maintain the fixed-deck claim firewall.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: fixed source actions and read-only evaluation intentionally exclude policy-selected evidence acquisition and later reconsolidation.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Keep all reports mechanically limited to fixed-deck memory representation/use; reserve on-policy flywheel claims for a separately ratified runtime and assay.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: optional expansion and multiple contrasts lack an executable finite-sample decision rule.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind paired estimator, multiplicity family, confidence construction, non-inferiority procedure, 12-to-16 expansion rule, seed nesting, missing-cell treatment, and all-world reporting before outcomes.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: one calibration seed and an unbound coupling/stability rule can promote favorable transport noise.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind paired training randomness, deterministic seed selection, calibration stability diagnostics, and promotion treatment of adapter variation before locked calibration.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: procedural world generation permits post-hoc difficulty or shortcut selection unless manifests and replacement rules are frozen.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind generator-family partitions, seeds, life/order and target manifests, rejection predicates, replacement rules, and development-access boundaries before locked outputs.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: one first-over-context endpoint supports only a bounded overlength comparison.
concern_dispositions.required_change: State that the confirmation endpoint is not a scaling claim; bind the pinned native maximum and checkpoint selection, and require a separately designed curve for any scaling conclusion.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the shuffle can change admission, corpus composition, coherence, and training difficulty in addition to action-outcome binding.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add a shuffle-decomposition analysis and, where feasible, matched controls for support counts, claim types, contradictions, corpus composition, candidate frequencies, and training difficulty.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: material gain, half-gain removal, aggregation, edge cases, and controller definitions are all material scientific choices left open.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind normalized-value aggregation, material and half-gain formulas including zero/negative cases, controller observation state, algorithms/prompts, priors, tie-breaking, and numerical-oracle validation.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: general manifests and reset audits do not exercise malformed outputs, repeat visibility, sealing, resumption, indeterminate calls, or cross-life contamination.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Add golden prompt/schema/parser/mask fixtures, fail-closed malformed/multi-operation tests, policy-visible repeat/reset checks, sealing and crash/resume tests, indeterminate-call handling, and cross-life canaries.

disagreements.issue: Whether the present architecture can proceed to any implementation before its deferred executable choices and authority stages are separately bound.

positions.position: AT10 is a future prerequisite that will bind executable choices before implementation.
The present before-implementation tests require implementation fixtures, making the stated ordering circular without an explicit staged authority protocol.

resolution.rationale: The critic is correct that the current bytes delimit architecture but do not define an executable authorization sequence. The proposal itself requires a new bundle and approval, so no implementation authority can be inferred now.
resolution.required_change: Submit a new hash-bound execution-bundle change with explicit stage authorities and newly registered coverage for stage ordering; then repeat fresh interpretation, critique, consensus, and human ratification.

disagreements.issue: Whether the visibility matrix and common reader already prevent goal, candidate, backend, runtime, and durability side channels.

positions.position: AT09 audits every model-visible surface and the common reader hides backend identity.
Exact goal bytes, reader-return fields, candidate behavior, failure behavior, prompt parsing, repeat state, and durability semantics are absent, so the channel is not testable.

resolution.rationale: A declarative forbidden-field matrix cannot establish information-channel equivalence without exact bytes and adversarial collision fixtures.
resolution.required_change: Bind all model-visible schemas and process behavior, and register new collision, reader-equivalence, runtime-golden, repeat, resume, and canary tests before implementation approval.

disagreements.issue: Whether later support and selector-derived replay can coexist with causal-prefix immutability and workspace-taint exclusion.

positions.position: Later outcomes append status only for later checkpoints; earlier artifacts remain immutable.
That necessary rule is interpretive rather than formal proposal bytes, and selectors can carry tainted branch influence despite public-handle payloads.

resolution.rationale: The systems interpretation supplies a coherent reading, but it cannot substitute for a bound snapshot/declassification contract.
resolution.required_change: Bind immutable snapshot objects and selector declassification/branch-status semantics; register exhaustive suffix and terminal-branch noninterference tests.

disagreements.issue: Whether existing atomic/provenance restrictions define valid support and cycle semantics for reusable claims.

positions.position: AT02 admits direct atoms and diamonds while rejecting cycles, descendant citations, equivalents, duplicates, and taint.
Identity across revisions and aliases, traversal semantics, claim-type support standards, and generator-level dependence are not bound.

resolution.rationale: Finite named fixtures cannot establish completeness for identity-dependent provenance or sufficiency for generalized causal claims.
resolution.required_change: Bind canonical identity, graph traversal, claim-type support rules, and property-based provenance/support tests in the new bundle.

disagreements.issue: Whether legal dependency traces and the oracle factorial establish causal constructive memory use rather than retrospective rationalization or an engineered resolver.

positions.position: Mechanically valid dependency DAGs, adaptive dependencies, non-adaptive floors, and stage scores distinguish legal composition from copying.
Those checks do not show cited reads caused action and may leave query ontology, candidate recognition, or resolver routing as the actual intelligence.

resolution.rationale: Population-level memory dependence and syntactic trace validity are necessary but insufficient for item-level causal attribution or protocol-neutrality.
resolution.required_change: Register cited-read intervention tests and query-scaffold/native-structure ablations; limit any passing result to the complete protocol until those tests pass.

disagreements.issue: Whether named controls and equal source/query/action budgets suffice for paper-facing comparison and fixed-memory substrate claims.

positions.position: Named R-rec, A-text, D-LoRA, common reader, and resource ledger provide the intended controlled comparisons.
Required standard baselines and substrate-neutral accounting remain absent; common output schema does not equalize candidate access or compute.

resolution.rationale: The proposal supports a ledger-specific bundled comparison, not the stronger comparative conclusions, until both baseline and resource ledgers are executable.
resolution.required_change: Bind the expanded paper baseline manifest and substrate-neutral capacity/compute ledger; report native explicit-structure performance separately from common-interface results.

disagreements.issue: Whether fixed-deck results, a dormant future edge, and a single post-context endpoint can support recurrence, revision, flywheel, or scaling implications.

positions.position: The future flywheel is inactive and claim firewall excludes on-policy, recurrence-superiority, and scaling claims.
The graph and recurrent language can still be misread; no matched cadence/bridge contrast or scaling curve is established, and A4 revision is only plumbing-ready.

resolution.rationale: The narrow firewall is retained, but it must be mechanically enforced and the future edge treated as a dormant reservation. No current result may be described beyond fixed-deck representation/use.
resolution.required_change: Bind report-language rejection rules and dormant-edge semantics; separately register revision, cadence/bridge, and scaling tests only if those claims are later sought.

disagreements.issue: Whether calibration promotion and claim-eligible confirmation are protected against optional sampling, adapter noise, and deck selection.

positions.position: AT11 preregisters paired confirmation, twin-pair clustering, nested adapter seeds, and a 12-or-16-pair rule.
The estimator, correction family, expansion rule, seed coupling, missing-cell handling, and locked generator/target/rejection manifests are not executable.

resolution.rationale: A stated intention to preregister is not an executable preregistration, and one-seed calibration can select transport noise.
resolution.required_change: Bind the complete estimator, optional-expansion, seed, failure, and split/rejection manifests before any locked calibration or confirmation.

disagreements.issue: Whether shuffle/twin interventions and the named gain thresholds identify authentic action-outcome binding and memory necessity.

positions.position: Matched shuffles, twins, no-memory controls, and half-gain thresholds establish binding and necessity.
Shuffle changes several corpus properties and gain/controller formulas are unbound, so neither estimand is reproducible or uniquely interpretable.

resolution.rationale: The interventions are valuable falsifiers, but their estimands require formulas and decomposition controls before they can bear the stated causal interpretation.
resolution.required_change: Bind gain/controller formulas and register shuffle decomposition/matching coverage in the repaired test registry.

questions: Whether to authorize preparation of a new exact execution-bundle proposal only, with no implementation or runs under this artifact.

Whether to ratify the repaired bundle only after it binds every unresolved information, provenance, baseline, resource, statistical, split, and runtime requirement and undergoes a new deliberation chain.
Whether recurrence, on-policy flywheel, scaling, and external-validity questions remain deferred to separately ratified changes.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: Accepted: the edge is a dormant architectural reservation only and must not be executable in this change.
Accepted: later support may enter only later append-only snapshots after formal causal-cut binding.
Accepted: current recurrence is checkpointed accumulation and adaptive within-item composition, not on-policy or learned recurrence.
Accepted: the repaired bundle must bind the broader baseline and bypass inventory before a paper-facing conclusion.
Accepted: cadence, bridge, and scale effects require separately registered contrasts and remain outside current claims.
Accepted: a substrate-neutral capacity and computation ledger is required before any fixed-memory or efficiency conclusion.
